derivations.solution: Equal interest over the same period means each part times its rate is the same, so \(5P_1 = 6P_2 = 9P_3 = k\). The parts are Rs. \(7200\), Rs. \(6000\) and Rs. \(4000\), so Rs. \(4{,}000\) was invested at \(9\%\).

derivations.solution: Take north as the starting direction. Turning \(150^\circ\) right points him \(150^\circ\) clockwise from north, and in \(15\) minutes at \(20\) km/hr he covers \(5\) km, of which the eastward part is \(5\sin 150^\circ = 2.5\) km. Turning \(60^\circ\) left points him due east, and in \(20\) minutes at \(30\) km/hr he covers a further \(10\) km, all eastward. Since both streets run north to south, the separation is the total eastward shift, \(2.5 + 10 = 12.5\) km.

derivations.solution: Each sector is a quarter circle of radius \(a\) centred at opposite corners, so the overlap is the lens cut out by two circles of radius \(a\) whose centres are \(a\sqrt2\) apart. derivations.solution: Cut an isosceles right triangle with legs \(x\) from each corner. The slanted cut then has length \(x\sqrt2\), while what remains of each original side is \(a - 2x\). derivations.solution: A border \(6\) inches wide is \(0.5\) ft, and it runs along both opposite edges, so it removes \(1\) ft from each dimension.
